text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains, with BTC up 1.6% and ETH up 1.1%, suggesting steady recovery momentum despite the market sitting in extreme fear territory. BTC dominance at 56.6% indicates investors are favoring the largest asset over altcoins, a typical pattern when sentiment is tentative. The $54B in 24-hour volume is moderate relative to the fear index—not yet enough to signal strong conviction, though the slight upward pressure across major tokens suggests some stabilization after recent declines.
